Ravi Singh: Quick pulse check — handbacks + manager review forms due EOD Fri PST. If you need an exception, reply here or DM people-ops.

Zoe Kim: If someone was on parental leave for 6 weeks mid-cycle, do we prorate goals or note LOA?

Ravi Singh: Prorate measurable core commitments where possible. If not meaningful, put N/A and add a one-line rationale in notes. That helps calibration.

Hannah Lewis: Is there a preferred calibration group size? Last time one session ran 2.5h. :grimacing:

Ravi Singh: Aim for 6-9 per live calibration block. If you have more, split into Group A / Group B and label in the template.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: 72h to deadline for 14 items in Ravi's queue. :alarm_clock:

Jorge Alvarez: Can I bulk set handback dates? I have 10 directs.

Ravi Singh: Yes. Use the CSV uploader. Canonical header: `email,manager,handback_date,proxy_reviewer,notes,preferred_slot`. Use ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 
```
email,manager,handback_date,proxy_reviewer,notes,preferred_slot
maria@redwood.com,jorge@redwood.com,2025-06-24,zoe@redwood.com,"prefers afternoon",PM
lee@redwood.com,jorge@redwood.com,2025-06-24,,"new hire prorated goals",AM
```
Zoe Kim: If manager is sole reviewer and becomes unavailable last minute, do you auto-assign?

Ravi Singh: We escalate to the manager's lead if no proxy. Best practice: add `proxy_reviewer` in the form or email people-ops@redwood.com before Thu noon.

Hannah Lewis: For confidential promotion cases, how should we flag?

Ravi Singh: Put `confidential: yes` in the template and a one-line reason. People-ops will prepare a redacted packet and schedule a private block with HR present.

Jorge Alvarez: Can managers request AM/PM slots?

Ravi Singh: Add `preferred_slot` (AM/PM) in CSV or template. We'll try to honor but no guarantees.

people-ops-bot: Note: upload endpoint max 8MB. If you hit limits, paste a small CSV snippet here or email people-ops. :mailbox_with_mail:

Zoe Kim: Thanks — uploading CSV now.

Ravi Singh: Thanks all — final calibration calendar posted by EOD Wed. Ping me for urgent exceptions. :wave:
